spec.scope: Full-charge attacks only, and only while self already holds Maillard
spec.durationSemantics: Extends the live Maillard window by +2.5 wall-clock sec per qualifying attack (a duration EXTENSION, not a fresh 10s refresh)
spec.triggerIdentity: Per full-charge shot fired (shotFired/chargeCounter equivalent), gated on self holding Maillard — a status-conditional per-shot extender
spec.targetSet: All allies (extends the team-wide Maillard window)
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoding it as a fresh buffApply of a 2.5s (or 10s) buff per charge shot, or letting it fire while Blanching is up
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Under default sim auto-fire (RL always full-charges) the Maillard state is never established, so NO event attributable to this line may appear; if Maillard were force-established via a patched override, expiresFrame of the Maillard buff must move out by 150 frames per subsequent charge shot rather than resetting to +600
spec.inertness: Must never create a standalone buffApply; must move zero damage in any default comp because Maillard never activates in-sim (RL never tap-fires)

spec.scope: Full-charge attacks only, and only while self already holds Blanching
spec.durationSemantics: Extends the live Blanching window by +2.5s per full-charge shot — engine schema has no duration-extension primitive (buffs refresh, not extend)
spec.triggerIdentity: Per full-charge shot, gated on self holding Blanching
spec.nearestWrongModel: Modeling the extension as an extra independent buff instance per shot (double-counting the ATK value), or asserting it matters when the 3-charge re-proc already refreshes 10s well inside any possible gap
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Blanching uptime after first application must be effectively continuous (~100%); arithmetic: charge cadence ≈ 60f charge + 22f release ≈ 1.37s/shot, re-proc every 3 shots ≈ 4.1s, max gap incl. the 141f reload ≪ 10s — so a plain 10s-refresh model is already gap-free and this line is derivably inert; assert exactly ONE live Blanching key per unit (value never doubles above 10% × caster ATK)
spec.inertness: Must not stack or add ATK value beyond the single 10% instance; board damage identical with or without the extension given the re-proc cadence

spec.kitLine: 3 normal atk w/o Full Charge → Maillard
spec.scope: Counts ONLY landed non-full-charge (tap) normal attacks — full-charge shots explicitly excluded
spec.durationSemantics: Maillard buff: 10 wall-clock sec (durationSec 10), not rounds
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount-style counter over NON-charged attacks only; in-sim an RL on auto ALWAYS full-charges, so this counter never advances — the entire Maillard branch is dead under default behavior
spec.targetSet: All allies (including self); the grant is casterAtkPct 10 (flat-resolves to ≈9,836.7 = 10% × Supporter 98,367); also strips Blanching (mutual exclusion)
spec.nearestWrongModel: The shared-prior misread: treating Maillard as the LIVE status (it is listed first) — e.g. keying it to a plain hitCount:3 that counts all rounds, which would make Maillard (not Blanching) the permanent team state and light up the burst's Distributed Damage ▲60%
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Event log over a full 180s default run must contain ZERO Maillard-attributable buffApply (no second casterAtkPct-10% key distinct from Blanching's), and ZERO distributedDamagePct buffApply from the burst; green under faithful (Maillard dead), red under the hitCount-counts-all-rounds misread
spec.inertness: Maillard's ATK grant and everything Maillard-gated (burst Distributed Damage ▲60%, S1 line 1) must move zero damage in any default comp

spec.scope: Counts full-charge attacks only (the '>1 sec maintain' qualifier — treat every sim full-charge shot as qualifying; a literal hold-past-full reading would make the whole kit inert, flag ⚑ the convention)
spec.durationSemantics: 10 wall-clock sec (durationSec 10), refreshed each re-proc; NOT rounds, NOT permanent
spec.triggerIdentity: chargeCounter count:3 (or hitCount:3 — equivalent here since RL hitsPerShot 1 and all shots are charged); first proc ≈ 3 × (60f + 22f) ≈ 4.1s in; removes Maillard on apply (inert removal in-sim)
spec.targetSet: All allies including self; casterAtkPct 10 → buffApply value flat-resolves to ≈9,836.7 (10% × 98,367 Supporter static ATK)
spec.nearestWrongModel: Requiring the literal ≥1s hold after reaching full charge (trigger never fires → Blanching dead → burst/S2 status gates all inert → massive under-credit); or targeting self only; or encoding value as raw 10 percentage points of the TARGET's ATK (atkPct) instead of a caster-scaled flat add
spec.distinguishingAssertion: A buffApply with stat 'casterAtkPct', value ≈9836.7, targeting all 5 unit indices, first appearing near frame ~250 (3 charge shots in) and recurring every ~3 charge shots; red under the never-fires misread (no such event) and under the atkPct misread (value 10, not ~9836.7)
spec.inertness: Must not apply per-shot (only every 3rd charge), must not exceed one live instance per target

loadBearingSet: skill1:3 Full Charge >1 sec → Blanching ATK ▲10%
notes: LOAD-BEARING PREMISE the driver must have verified: the sim's RL auto-fire ALWAYS full-charges (chargeFrames 60 + 22f release latency, never tap-fires). Everything branches on it — Blanching is the sole live status, the whole Maillard family (S1 lines 1&3, S2 line 1, burst Distributed ▲60%) is dead, and the burst's Sustained ▲10% is the live payload. EXPECTED SHARED-PRIOR MISREADS: (1) branch selection — Maillard is listed first and 'normal attack' pattern-matches to ordinary firing, so a plausible driver models Maillard as the standing state and ships the 60% distributedDamagePct over-credit; the paired assertions (zero distributedDamagePct ever / sustainedDamagePct==10 at burstCast) catch either direction of the swap. (2) Trigger tier swap on skill2's FB-enter line ('when entering Full Burst' = fullBurstEnter, every team FB) vs the burst block (burstCast, only her own rotations) — these diverge precisely because crust is Burst II sharing the tier with the fixture's crown: verify the fixture actually lets crust cast (controlComp puts the carry in the B3 slot; a B2 subject needs either a custom comp or explicit handling of B2 alternation, and tests must locate rotations where crust did NOT cast to prove the fullBurstEnter line still fires there). (3) The '>1 sec maintain' qualifier read literally would make ALL triggers dead — flag ⚑ the every-full-charge-shot convention rather than silently choosing. (4) casterAtkPct flat-resolution: assert values ≈9,836.7 (10%) and ≈19,673.4 (20%) of Supporter static ATK 98,367, never the raw percentages. Structural GAPs to reconcile: no ally-status target primitive (collapse to plain allies with the Blanching-uptime derivation stated in the note) and no duration-extension primitive (derivably inert here — re-proc every ~4.1s ≪ 10s duration, reload included).
